items.title: Baengnokdam Lake (한라산 백록담)
items.description: Baengnokdam is a crater lake that sits on top of Hallasan Mountain at the center of Jeju Island. It spans 3 kilometers in circumference and 500 meters in diameter, and is surrounded by approximately 360 parasitic cones. At the peak, visitors can feel like floating on clouds.

detailInfo.name: Mountain Not Access Period
detailInfo.text:
[Seongpanak Trail] 
 May-August: Seongpanak Trail Entrance & Azalea Shelter restricted from 13:00
 November-February: Trail entrance starting from 06:00, Seonpanak Trail & Azalea Shelter restricted from 12:00, Baengnokdam restricted from 13:30
 [Gwaneumsa Temple Trail] 
 May-August: Gwaneumsa Temple Trail Entrance & Samgakbong Shelter restricted from 13:00
 November-February: Trail entrance starting from 06:00, Gwaneumsa Temple Trail & Samgakbong Shelter restricted from 12:00, Baengnokdam restricted from 13:30

detailInfo.name: Hiking Course
detailInfo.text:
[Seongpanak Trail]
 Seongpanak Visitors Center→Sokbat Shelter→Saraakoreum Entrance→Azalea Field Shelter→Dongneung Peak 
 [Gwaneumsa Temple Trail]
 Gwaneumsa→Tamnagyegok Valley→Gaemimok→Samgakbong Shelter→Dongneung Peak

detailInfo.name: Parking Fees
detailInfo.text:
- Two-wheel vehicles: 500 won
- Small vehicles (displacement less than 1,000 cc): 1,000 won
- Cars (loading capacity less than 4 tons): 1,800 won 
- Small bus (11-15 passengers): 3,000 won
- Mid/Large bus (more than 16 passengers): 3,700 won
